items.title: Formal etaleness of a morphism of schemes is detected affine locally
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent formulations of formal etaleness for a morphism of schemes: the morphism itself, its restriction to compatible open subschemes, the ring-map condition on every pair of compatible affine opens, and the same condition on one chosen affine cover. The implications need the compatibility of formal etaleness with open immersions and the passage from affine-local ring maps back to the morphism, so the local-to-global direction is where the work is. Retained author proof at lines 1672-1688 statement, proof 1690-1705.
